text: Navbar Commands dropdown lists the 17 command pages in order and each entry opens its page
Top-level links (brand, Utilities, Cypress API, GitHub) navigate to the right destination
Browser history back/forward and reload behave correctly across pages
Every page is reachable directly by URL (HTTP 200, clean URLs, .html redirects); unknown URLs return 404
Section headings are deep-linkable anchors with documentation links
Navbar collapses into a hamburger toggle below the 768 px breakpoint and stays operable
Todo filters are routed through the URL hash (#/, #/active, #/completed)
Text, email and password inputs accept typed text including special keys, Unicode and long values
The email field applies HTML5 e-mail syntax validation
Focusing the password field highlights it (class focus, label orange)
Leaving the full-name field marks it (class error, label red)
Clearing the description field empties it
Submitting the coupon form shows a green confirmation without reloading the page
Enabled checkboxes can be checked/unchecked individually or together; disabled ones cannot
Radio buttons are mutually exclusive; the disabled radio cannot be selected
Single select offers a placeholder plus three fruits and selects exactly one
Multi-select allows any subset of the three fruits
Range slider (0–100, step 1) echoes its value when changed
The disabled textarea cannot be edited by a user
Forms on the Querying, Misc and Waiting pages accept input
Clicking the canvas draws a red dot at the pointer position
Buttons and labels toggle Bootstrap popovers; mouse events reach handlers
A button covered by an overlay is not clickable by a user
Double-clicking the editable label reveals a focused input
Right-clicking the editable label reveals a focused input
Scroll containers can bring hidden buttons into view and scroll to named positions
Clickable list items and table buttons change state when clicked
Clock and tick widgets show the current epoch time in seconds
Pages render without horizontal scrolling on phone, tablet and desktop viewports
Assertions page content, classes, attributes and the delayed random number are as documented
Querying and traversal pages expose the documented DOM structure
A todo is added with Enter; titles are trimmed; empty/whitespace titles are ignored
The counter reads 'N item left' for N=1 and 'N items left' otherwise
Items can be completed and re-activated individually and all at once
Double-click edits: Enter/blur saves (trimmed), Escape cancels, empty deletes
An item can be deleted with its × button
'Clear completed' appears only when completed items exist and removes them
All / Active / Completed filters show the right subset
The list persists in localStorage across reloads
Titles are rendered as text (HTML-escaped) on create and edit
List and footer are hidden when there are no todos
Get Comment shows the comment body returned by the API
Post Comment shows 'POST successful!'
Update Comment shows the API error message on 404
Fixtures and files can be loaded, read and written
Storage button writes 3 localStorage and 3 sessionStorage keys
Cookie buttons set token=123ABC; cookies can be read and cleared
Pages meet WCAG 2.1 AA (axe-core) and are keyboard operable
Pages load within budget (DCL < 1.5 s, load < 3 s, ≤ 30 requests, ≤ 1.5 MB); interactions < 100 ms
No stored XSS; secure headers and server hygiene audited
Works in Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Electron
Key components are visually stable against committed baselines
No console errors, uncaught exceptions or broken assets on any page
